title: The Content Moderator’s Dilemma: Removal of Toxic Content and Distortions to Online Discourse

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the semantic distortion of online discourse caused by toxicity filtering using the Bhattacharyya distance on Transformer-based text embeddings, and using a Top2Vec topic model to demonstrate the disproportionate removal of specific discussion topics (e.g., Racism, Trump, Black Lives Matter).

Evaluating how the removal or rephrasing of toxic content structurally alters the plurality (variance) and mean semantic representation within a dataset of 5 million US political tweets, thereby shifting the overall composition of political debates.
